note: Where a roadmap and its steps open on the web: each address is what follows the app's origin. The backend builds every case (backend/products/roadmap/domain/WebAddress), and the web proves its router opens each one (web/test/products/roadmap/addresses.test.js). A tree id is always t_ plus 16 lowercase hex, so it is written as it is; a step id is encoded as encodeURIComponent does. A case with no nodeId is the roadmap's own address. localOrigin is the origin a local stack serves the app on: the backend hands out addresses on it when WINDMILL_APP_URL is unset (backend/platform/infra/AppOrigin.h), and the web's dev server is pinned to its port (web/vite.config.js).
